EXPLANATION: The intense 2125 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with an internal alkyne C≡C stretch (typical ~2100–2200) rather than a nitrile (expected ~2220–2260; none observed). Strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2921/2938/2988 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1433/1458 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) match a saturated framework. Multiple bands in the 790–900 cm⁻¹ region are characteristic of cyclohexane ring modes, supporting the presence of a cyclohexyl group. Absence of O–H (~3200–3600) and N–H (~3300–3400) peaks disfavors candidates with OH or NH/C≡N. These features best fit CCC#CC1CC(C)C1.
